MOST IMMEDIATE
No. 1/34/1/2026-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)
New Delhi, the 15th October, 2026
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 15th October, 2026, Dr. L.
Murugan relinquished the charge of the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of
Information and Broadcasting; and the charge of the office of the Minister of State in the
Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs.
Amethi 15/10/2026
(Anita Tripathi)
for Cabinet Secretary
